title: Various Laws relating to Corporate Sustainability Reporting (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act I of 2026)
citation: Act I of 2026, Government Gazette of Malta No. 21,592, 26.02.2026; amends the Accountancy Profession Act (Cap. 281), the Companies Act (Cap. 386) and subsidiary legislation
evidence: L.N. 61 of 2026 (Government Gazette No. 21,607, 20.03.2026): "the Minister responsible for the registration of commercial partnerships has established the date of the publication of this Legal Notice as the date on which the provisions of articles 17, 26, 27, 28, 29, 31, 41 and 42 of the said Act shall come into force." Art. 1(2) of the Act: "This Act shall come into force on such date or dates as the Minister ... may by notice in the Gazette establish". legislation.mt shows Data ta' dħul fis-Seħħ 2026-03-20 and the status Parzjalment fis-seħħ (partly in force). Opened https://legislation.mt/eli/act/2026/1/eng and https://legislation.mt/eli/ln/2026/61/eng on 2026-11-02.
notes: Transposes Directive (EU) 2022/2464 (CSRD) at Act level with the regulations in mt-csr-regulations-2026. Only the as-published text is stored: the Act is partly in force, and the page lists no later commencement notice, so the date is the first in-force date for articles 17, 26, 27, 28, 29, 31, 41 and 42 and the record message says so. The consolidated Companies Act (Cap. 386) and Accountancy Profession Act (Cap. 281) are not instruments here; the site's consolidated Cap. 386 is a whole-Act text and was not cut. Languages stored on 2026-11-02: en and mt, both authentic texts on legislation.mt (Constitution art. 74: the Maltese text prevails on conflict unless Parliament provides otherwise), from the English and Maltese PDF of each dated version under the same row; no separate government translation exists or is needed.

title: Consumer Affairs Act (Cap. 378), Part VIII Title I: unfair commercial practices (articles 48 to 51J)
citation: Consumer Affairs Act (Cap. 378) Part VIII Title I, as replaced by Act II of 2008 (Directive 2005/29/EC)
evidence: Article 51J of the consolidated Act: the Title implements Directive 2005/29/EC. No official page opened states the date the Title took effect: the Title is marked "Added by: II. 2008.28" (Act II of 2008, published 2008-01-29 per the site timeline) and the Act has no commencement clause in the text read.
notes: General unfair-commercial-practices law under which an environmental claim can be a misleading practice; Malta has no green-claims-specific statute on legislation.mt. Directive (EU) 2024/825 (empowering consumers for the green transition, applies from 2026-09-27): no transposing Act or Legal Notice is on legislation.mt on 2026-11-02 (the 325 Acts and Legal Notices of 2026 were checked by title; L.N. 145 of 2026 transposes Directive (EU) 2023/2673 instead), so no entry. Records are the Title cut from the consolidated Act, from the heading of Part VIII to the line before the Title II heading, stored only when the cut text differs from the previous consolidation in either language: 2019-10-01, 2021-08-31, 2022-10-21, 2023-06-25, 2023-07-14 (the consolidations of 2022-01-01 and 2023-09-19 have the same Title text). The site lists no consolidation before 2019-10-01 (the earliest entry, 1996-01-23, has no file) and none after 2023-09-19. in_force is null for the instrument because the Title's own first date is not stated on an official page; each record carries its consolidation date.
